blocks.html:
The USI research network contemplates several national and international partners.

The University and its affiliate Institutes:

  • coordinate or take part in research platforms such as PASC, the National Centres of Competence in Research (NCCR) and the Swiss Competence Centres for Energy Research
  • cooperate with other institutions within doctoral programmes
  • are part of a vast dedicated scientific network of researchers who carry out projects and supervise publications in collaboration with colleagues around the word.
